findings.claim: The patch makes an unrelated security-sensitive change by raising UntrustedData.MaximumObjectGraphDepth from the recorded limit of 500 to 5000. This weakens the object-graph depth defense by allowing ten times as many nested objects before the guard applies, and is not part of the referenced-assembly crash fix. The value should remain 500.

receipt_plan.detail: Cite ledger entry L9, which records the stack depth limit of 500 even for trusted data, and compare it with the changed UntrustedData value of 5000. REQ-2283 contains no requirement to alter this security limit.
